canonical_spec_json.name: Overnight relative mean reversion RNVDA vs RQQQ
canonical_spec_json.rationale: Autonomous cycle 1 proposal. The signal measures the 24-bar return of RQQQUSDT minus RNVDAUSDT during overnight sessions. A high z-score of this spread suggests RNVDA has underperformed RQQQ on a relative basis and is expected to revert. No performance is claimed; this is a falsifiable hypothesis for schema validation and transport testing only.
canonical_spec_json.thesis: When RNVDAUSDT's overnight close-to-close return diverges positively from RQQQUSDT's over a 24-bar lookback, the spread tends to mean-revert; entering on extreme positive divergence and exiting when the spread normalizes captures this reversion.
